steps.text: Talk to Father Aereck in the Lumbridge Church.
Talk to Father Urhney, west of the Lumbridge Swamp.
choices: Father Aereck sent me to talk to you.
He's got a ghost haunting his graveyard.

steps.text: Open the coffin in the Lumbridge Graveyard to spawn the ghost.
Search the coffin in the Lumbridge Graveyard to spawn the ghost.
Speak to the Ghost that appears whilst wearing your Ghostspeak Amulet.
choices: Yep, now tell me what the problem is.
Yes, ok. Do you know WHY you're a ghost?
Yes, ok. Do you know why you're a ghost?

steps.text: Enter the Wizards' Tower basement, south of Draynor village.
Search the Altar. A skeleton (level 13) will appear and attack you, but you can just run away.
Open the ghost's coffin in the Lumbridge graveyard.
Search the coffin to put the skull back and finish the quest.

combat: A skeleton (level 13) you can run away from
